alcance: Working days describe the workplace calendar. They do not establish that the person was scheduled to work.
limites: This demonstration does not calculate working time, minutes, attendance, balances or administrative deadlines. It does not query Personal or official sources.
fuentes: Source references and hashes are declared demonstration data. Documents, files and links are never opened. Input and result hashes support reproduction and comparison.
determinado: The interval has one assignment and a complete workplace calendar.
parcial: Some intervals have a calendar; others cannot be determined.
indeterminado: The calendar for this interval cannot be determined.
adscripcion_multiple: Several assignments cover the same dates. The demonstration does not choose one.
calendario_sin_cobertura: A required workplace calendar layer is missing for this year.
calendario_no_disponible: A complete calendar could not be retrieved.
programacion_persona_no_disponible: The person's schedule profile and roster are missing.
presencia_y_saldo_fuera_de_alcance: Time records and balances are outside this demonstration.
entrada_invalida: The input is not a valid demonstration. Supply one synthetic JSON document on standard input with no arguments.
consulta_no_disponible: The query could not be reproduced using the supplied snapshot and knowledge time.
salida_no_disponible: The result could not be written.
